meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 装上后,当你报 bug 时 Claude 会拉取最新 LazyCodex 与上游 Codex 源码、跑最小复现确认根因,判断该由哪个仓库负责,并在那里创建带证据的 GitHub issue(仅 openai/codex 可开 PR)。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交或分类 LazyCodex、Codex 插件、上游 Codex CLI 等 bug 时触发。

say.text: 帮我报个 LazyCodex 安装器的 bug:装完后 hook 不跑

say.text: 先搜有没有重复 issue,有的话把新证据评论上去

howto.what_en: After install, Claude pulls the latest LazyCodex and upstream Codex sources, reproduces the bug to confirm root cause, decides which repo owns it, and files an evidence-backed issue there (PRs only for openai/codex).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to report, file, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, a Codex plugin, upstream Codex CLI, etc.

say_en.text: Report a LazyCodex installer bug for me: the hook doesn't run after install
say_en.note: Reproduces first, then opens an issue

say_en.text: This Codex CLI crash reproduces on upstream too, file it on openai/codex
Search for duplicates first; comment new evidence on an existing issue
